name: Dennis Low
shortBio: Senior Real Estate Negotiator with PropNex Malaysia, helping homeowners and buyers navigate apartment, commercial and landed property opportunities across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor.
longBio: As a Senior Real Estate Negotiator with PropNex Malaysia, Dennis Low focuses on prime projects around the KLCC area, Setia Alam and Setia Eco Park. He works with homeowners and buyers across apartment sales, commercial property and landed houses, providing clear guidance through the next property decision.
